As a software engineer with over 20 years of experience architecting and building large-scale data systems for companies such as Orange Telecom and Telefónica, I have spent the recent years designing and shipping production-grade AI applications for numerous mid-market teams.

Over the last half-decade, I’ve seen the same challenges come up again and again…

- CTOs struggling to define where AI starts, how it fits their company and what the real ROI is.
- Promising prototypes that look great in demos but fall apart (or become unreliable) once they hit real production.
- AI outputs drifting, hallucinating, or showing biases at the worst possible moments.
- Strong engineering teams that still aren't using AI tools and practices to work 10× faster.

That's exactly why I now focus on helping mid-market companies turn those challenges into practical, production-ready AI.

:::

:::

### Your First AI Win
You see competitors moving ahead with AI and need a clear path that doesn’t risk your core operations or reputation.

I help you build an AI roadmap by selecting a non-critical business process and architecting a production-grade, low-friction solution. This allows you to gain familiarity with AI implementation through a low-risk project that protects your professional reputation while creating a foundation for future scaling.
